    name='move_robowits_ee_to',

    max_steps=96,
    max_translation=0.3,
    evidence_handles=evidence_handles
)
print(f"Move to pregrasp ok: {result_move.ok}")
if result_move.ok:

# The screw is very close - try a tiny push directly toward container center
# Move slightly up and toward container
result_tiny_push = primitives.call(
    name='execute_robowits_ee_control',
    arm='right',
    target_position=[container_pos[0] - 0.01, container_pos[1] - 0.02, container_pos[2] - 0.05],
    gripper_width=0.09,
    max_translation=0.02,
    repeat_steps=5,
    evidence_handles=evidence_handles
)
print(f"Tiny push ok: {result_tiny_push.ok}")

# Check final screw position
result_screw_final = primitives.call(name='locate_robowits_entity', entity_name='screw')
screw_final = result_screw_final.output['selected']['pos']
print(f"Screw final: {screw_final}")
